questions.question: What did Nebuchadnezzar's dream of a great tree foretell?
options: That a great famine would strike the whole land
That he would be driven out to live like a beast
That his kingdom would be divided among his sons
That a foreign army would soon conquer Babylon
questions.answer: That he would be driven out to live like a beast

questions.question: What happened to Nebuchadnezzar as the dream foretold?
options: He was slain by his own scheming officials in the deep dark of the night
He lost his sanity and ate grass like an ox for seven periods of time
He was struck completely blind and could not rule for a whole year
He fled away from the city and lived all alone out in the desert
questions.answer: He lost his sanity and ate grass like an ox for seven periods of time

questions.question: When Nebuchadnezzar's reason returned, he praised and honored the Most High.
The Most High rules the kingdom of men and gives it to whom he _____.
Those who walk in pride God is able to _____.
